## What this change does

Write what the change does and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or changed tests.
- [ ] `bin/rake` passes.
- [ ] `bin/rubocop` passes.
- [ ] `bin/rake rbs` passes.
- [ ] If I changed the public API, I updated `sig/feedbackpilgrim.rbs`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] The change adds no runtime dependency and no telemetry.
- [ ] The change has no token, secret or other key.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:` and similar).
